ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher; note that the driver's "I'm Here" tap at 12:06:15 was ~780 m from Bugis Junction, so NS-1 is not satisfied; issue a driver-side reminder on the "I'm Here" button.
ruling.reasoning:
Dispute is a no-show cancellation fee (NS-0, cancelled_by = driver, driver asserts rider no-show → NS-1/NS-2). Safety screen: chat, complaint and driver statement contain no threat, harassment, abuse or dangerous-driving allegation — nothing to escalate.

NS-1 requires all three: (i) driver pressed "I'm Here"; (ii) at that moment GPS placed him at the pickup point (≤200 m); (iii) he then waited continuously >3 min within 200 m until cancelling.

(i) satisfied: driver_pressed_here_at = 12:06:15, and the driver's own chat message at 12:06:20 confirms it.

(ii) fails. Pickup (Bugis Junction) is at 1.2994, 103.8555. At 12:06:15 the GPS trace (5 s grid, thinned) puts the driver at ~1.30476, 103.85487 — roughly 0.0070° north, i.e. ≈ 780 m from the pickup point, far outside the 200 m data-layer radius. The trace from 12:06:00 through 12:09:25 shows the vehicle stationary at that same spot (speed 0–2 km/h), never approaching Bugis Junction; the last moving sample at 12:05:30 was still ~1.13 km north. The rider's message at 12:07:15 ("no car here") and the driver's stationary position agree with the rider's account; the system trace therefore overrides the driver's statement that he was at the pickup.

(iii) also fails in substance: even if the ~3 min 10 s stationary period counted, it occurred at a location ~780 m from the pickup point, not within 200 m of it.

Because NS-1 (ii) (and effectively (iii)) is not met, NS-2 applies: the $6.61 cancellation fee is refunded in full (refund_full). No flag_account: NS-2's account flag attaches only when the driver was outside the radius at the tap AND NS-1 is otherwise argued as a no-show abuse; here the fee was refunded rather than the driver's tap being used to trigger a waiting/no-show charge, and profile facts (a prior upheld no-show dispute) cannot alone justify a flag.

rejected_claims.reason: Claim that he "waited more than 3 minutes at the pickup" is contradicted by the GPS trace: from 12:06:00 to 12:09:25 he was stationary at ~1.30476, 103.85487, about 780 m from Bugis Junction, never entering the 200 m arrival radius. System records override statements.
Driver's chat "I'm here already" at 12:06:20 is not supported by GPS: the vehicle was ~780 m north of the pickup point at that time.
